claim_boundary: Deterministic correctness diagnosis only. No latency, throughput, runtime ranking, or formal performance result was measured.

baseline.sampling: greedy with the five OmniInfer ignore_eos EOG rows excluded before selection

hypothesis_probes.hypothesis: The fused GDN core changes the hidden state enough to cause step46.
hypothesis_probes.prediction: Selecting the legacy four-dispatch constructor removes the mismatch or changes its first position.
hypothesis_probes.single_variable: candidate GDN core profile: fused versus legacy
hypothesis_probes.result: Fused and legacy produced the same sole mismatch, same top-4 rows, and identical candidate teacher, rerank, and free-run hashes.

hypothesis_probes.hypothesis: A common W8 body precision effect is sufficient; Stack3, boundary, tail-head fusion, and the Metal head are not required.
hypothesis_probes.prediction: The existing all-linear-layers GDN-out-G32-v2 lane, which uses independent layer transactions and a CPU/F32 head, reproduces step46.
hypothesis_probes.single_variable: body transaction topology and head implementation
hypothesis_probes.result: The all-linear lane reproduced only step46 token 123 to 109 and its complete teacher output hash equalled fused and legacy.

hypothesis_probes.hypothesis: One production-matching GDN-out-G32 packed W8 linear layer is individually sufficient to flip the near tie.
hypothesis_probes.prediction: At least one of the 18 single-layer CPU packed-reference probes selects token 109 at step46.
hypothesis_probes.single_variable: one linear-attention layer changed from CPU/F32 to CPU packed-W8 GDN-out-G32
hypothesis_probes.result: All 18 probes selected token 123 and had zero mismatches through step46. Several layers shifted the 109-minus-123 margin toward zero, so the full-body flip is cumulative rather than attributable to one layer.

step46_logit_margin_probe.definition: logit(token 109) minus logit(token 123); a negative value selects token 123 if neither is beaten by another row

layer0_precision_factor_probe.interpretation: Local precision changes are not monotonic with restoration of this CPU/F32 token ordering; no single projection profile is justified as a fix from this probe.

root_cause_assessment.high_confidence: The step46 difference is a deterministic, cumulative W8 body precision effect on a near-tied pair of logits.
high_confidence_exclusions: fused GDN core versus legacy four-dispatch GDN core
checked reset or free-run state selection
root_cause_assessment.medium_confidence_boundary: The evidence does not assign the cumulative drift to one projection family; the tested layer0 GDN-output and MLP-down precision changes were non-monotonic for this token margin.
root_cause_assessment.not_observed: No hard implementation failure, nondeterminism, EOG-mask leak, out-of-vocabulary candidate, duplicate candidate, or retry was observed.

fix_candidates.candidate: Align the semantic gate with its stated cross-runtime contract: require the exact five-row suppression policy, no excluded EOG output, valid candidate coverage/rerank, deterministic replay, and teacher/free self-consistency; retain CPU/F32 token identity as an informational quality diagnostic rather than cross-runtime semantic identity.
fix_candidates.condition: Use only if the gate is intended to admit equivalent sampling policy across differently quantized runtimes, as its current claim boundary states.

fix_candidates.candidate: If exact CPU/F32 trajectory identity is a hard product requirement, introduce and qualify a separately named higher-precision whole-body portfolio against the complete 128-step gate.
fix_candidates.condition: Do not infer a winning projection profile from the layer0 factor probe; measure the complete path because local precision was non-monotonic.

fix_candidates.candidate: Freeze the admitted ApxInf W8 suppressed trajectory and use it as a deterministic resident-server replay invariant while keeping the OmniInfer trajectory explicitly informational.
fix_candidates.condition: This guards reset and serving regressions without claiming identical weights or token trajectories across runtimes.

forbidden_shortcuts: calling this diagnostic a performance result
